dedupe_keys.name: opnv guteklassen in den deutschen landkreisen und gemeinden 2025

description: ÖPNV-Güteklassen in den deutschen Landkreisen und Gemeinden 2025 is a dataset listed in Data Atlas of Civil Society, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Greenpeace e.V.. Public transport in Germany is part of public services and a prerequisite for getting to school or work, doing shopping, visiting doctors, visiting the theatre, meeting friends and relatives. A good public transport offer helps to establish equal opportunities for all population groups and to approximate the living conditions in the city and country. Coverage: Greenpeace e.V.. The portal shows the English title as "Public transport quality classes in the German counties and municipalities 2025" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Greenpeace e.V.. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, GPKG. The listing shows 2025-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.dcat-ap.de/def/licenses/20210721#cc-by-nc/4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datenatlas-zg.
